description:
A wooden fortress stood on the site, and King Ottokar II of Bohemia replaced it with a stone castle that became the seat of the Lordship of Poděbrady. King John pledged the lordship and the castle to Hynek of Lichtenburg in 1345, and in 1350 the castle came to the Kunštát family through the marriage of Hynek's daughter to Boček I of Poděbrady. According to legend, King George of Poděbrady, Boček's great-grandson, was born in the castle.

The castle passed to King Vladislaus II in 1495 and stayed with the Bohemian Crown until 1839. It was reconstructed in the Renaissance style between 1548 and 1580 and in the Baroque style in 1723–1724, with further changes after 1750, although a Czech tourism source dates the Baroque work to 1723–1780.

Maria Theresa stayed here several times, and under Joseph II it housed retired army officers. In 1839 the Crown sold the castle and lordship to the Viennese banker Georg Simon Sina. Today the historic part of the castle houses a small hotel with a private wellness area, in the centre of the spa town on the Elbe.

faqs.question: Is the hotel inside Poděbrady Castle?
faqs.answer: Yes. It occupies the historic part of the castle in the centre of Poděbrady, beside the Elbe.

faqs.question: Who was born at Poděbrady Castle?
faqs.answer: According to legend, King George of Poděbrady, who ruled Bohemia in the 15th century, was born here.

meta_title: Poděbrady Castle, Czech Republic — Royal Castle Hotel
meta_description: Stay at Poděbrady Castle beside the Elbe in the spa town of Poděbrady, Czech Republic — the traditional birthplace of King George. From approx. €159/night.

hotel.room_location_note: Rooms are in the historic part of Poděbrady Castle, Jiřího náměstí 1; ask the hotel which building your room is in
hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** In the centre of Poděbrady beside the Elbe, at Jiřího náměstí 1, within a short walk of the town's railway and bus stops according to Spa.cz; Booking lists parking, and Spa.cz says parking at the hotel is paid.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €159/night for a 20 m² Superior Double Room with a queen bed, air conditioning, a private bathroom, a flat-screen TV, a minibar and free Wi-Fi, with breakfast and high-speed internet included on the non-refundable rate seen; a free-cancellation rate was around €176. Booking shows a small tax charge (about €2) separately, and some member-only discounts that are not included here.

**On-site:** A private wellness area with a whirlpool and a Finnish sauna, a buffet breakfast and rooms in the historic part of the castle; the nearest restaurants are a short walk away.

**Good to know:** Rates were seen for one February 2027 stay, a low-season date, so check your own dates on Booking. Booking lists the property under the name "Zámecký hotel & Wellness", and some listings call it a guesthouse, so check that you are booking the castle hotel at Jiřího náměstí.

**Combine with:** [More castle hotels in Czech Republic](/castle-hotels/czech-republic).
